The token's value is ASSUMED (the task's 1, 2, 3, ...). Refused: READNEXT / READPREV UPDATE [TOKEN] (RLS only), DELETE TOKEN with RIDFLD or GENERIC, REWRITE TOKEN whose FROM has another key

A scenario can plan ENQBUSY (RESP 55) for an ENQ by the RESOURCE operand as the program writes it; RESP2 is 0 because IBM states none for ENQBUSY. The ENQ must say NOSUSPEND: without it IBM suspends the task and the runtimes refuse. infeasible_stated.reason: `IF COMM-FAIL-CODE = '2'` (l.406, under `IF COMM-SUCCESS = 'N'` after PERFORM UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO at l.398) is false only if UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with a fail code other than '2'. The paragraph sets 'N' at l.1044 and leaves it only by GO TO UADT999 (l.1181) after MOVE '2' (l.1103, the +100 arm) or by the 'Y' at l.1557; the other fail code it sets, '3' (l.1188), is followed by the -911 handling and then COMPUTE/UPDATE from unset host variables, and every failure after that (UPDATE -180, the deadlock/timeout exhaustion arms, a failing SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return. No input returns 'N' with a code other than '2' (the to-select/to-update -911 and 923 scenarios all abend).

`IF COMM-FAIL-CODE NOT = '2'` (l.766, the ELSE of `IF COMM-SUCCESS = 'Y'` at l.606 after PERFORM UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO at l.600) is true only if UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with a fail code other than '2': the same fact as the false arm of l.406 -- UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns 'N' only by GO TO UADT999 after MOVE '2' (l.1103/1181); its other failure code '3' (l.1188) goes on to an UPDATE that fails -180 and ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return.
